thread:
anne-marketing: Hey runtime — quick ask for launch prep. We need a focused smoke/sweep today targeting three payload cohorts + quantized variants. Goal: P50/P95/P99, cold-start vs warm, and per-model token-cost breakdown for webinar slides tomorrow. CC @sam-runtime @eli-eng :pray:

sam-runtime: Got it. Quick clarifying q's — which payload cohorts exactly? target sample size and concurrency? and do you want warmup procedure documented?

anne-marketing: Cohorts: 1) short chat prompts (~1–3 turns, ~60 tokens) 2) long-context generation (1 input -> ~2k output, use max_tokens=2048) 3) many-short (100–200 short prompts like search snippets). Sample: 250 requests per cohort. Concurrency: light (5 concurrent) to reflect demo traffic. Warmup: yes — deterministic seed, and run 10 warmup requests per worker before measuring. Use seed=42. Prioritize quantized AB test (int8), fp16 as baseline.

sam-runtime: OK. I'll run: quantized-int8, fp16, and a 'kv-pruned' variant if possible. Confirming configs: batch_size=1 (real demo), max_tokens per cohort as you said, random_seed=42, samples=250. Also confirm region — us-west-2 only for the slides?

anne-marketing: us-west-2 only, thanks. Also include a tiny cross-region sanity (eu-west-1) for tail latencies if easy. Not required for every variant.

eli-eng: Add P50 to the metrics list please — marketing usually wants median for context. Also capture first-byte latency to show cold-start.

sam-runtime: Will capture P50/P95/P99, first-byte and last-byte latencies, and token-cost (estimated $/1k tokens) per model variant. Will save raw logs + summarized CSV. Suggest warmup command:

sam-runtime: ```bash
# warmup (run on each worker)
for i in {1..10}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDSHIFT_BENCH_KEY\" \
    -d '{"model":"<model>","input":"warmup prompt","max_tokens":512,"seed":42}' \
  >/dev/null
done
```

noah-qa: Please ensure artifacts go to S3 and that we keep raw token-level trace for at least 7 days. Also include reproducible config JSON in the artifact.

sam-runtime: Will dump to s3://redwood-prod-bench/marketing/launch/1719998000/ with subfolders raw/ and summary/. I'll attach a presigned link in this thread when done.

bench-bot: Scheduled benchmark job 1719998000-01 created for models: rdx-large-fp16, rdx-large-int8, rdx-large-kvprune. ETA ~2h.

anne-marketing: Amazing — one more ask: tag any CSV rows that are 'deck-ready' (stable numbers, no >10% variance across reruns). We'll pick the most stable numbers for slides. Also include warmup vs no-warmup diffs.

sam-runtime: Understood. We'll run 3 micro-reruns for variance estimate and mark rows with sd/mean <= 0.10 as deck-ready. Will include warmup/no-warmup delta columns.

eli-eng: If you run into heavy variance, try fixed worker pinning and set affinity to reduce noisy neighbors.

sam-runtime: Good call. I'll pin workers for the quantized jobs.

noah-qa: Reminder: preserve prompt set used (anonymize PII) and attach reproducibility notes (docker image, runtime sha).

sam-runtime: Yep — adding: runtime_sha=ff43a2b, docker: redwood/runtime:2026-03-21.

bench-bot: Job 1719998000-01 started. Progress updates will be posted here.

anne-marketing: Thank you team — if we can get presigned links and a 1-slide CSV summary by EOD that would be incredible. :rocket:

sam-runtime: Aiming for EOD. Will post link + short summary with recommended numbers for the webinar deck.

noah-qa: I can sanity check the summary once posted. :thumbsup:

sam-runtime: Quick note — if any quantized run OOMs, I'll fallback to smaller batch_size or sequence cap and annotate the change in the config JSON.

anne-marketing: Perfect. Appreciate it.

bench-bot: Job 1719998000-01 update: quantized-int8: 80/250 done; fp16: 60/250 done. ETA ~1h45m.

sam-runtime: Will update thread with s3 link when complete.

anne-marketing: Thanks — keeping fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
